base_lineage: semantic-judge-v1-4 (V1.4 semantics unchanged; labels, verdict meanings, and derivation authority preserved)

M1_hedged_assertion_evaluability.rule: MATCH + ASSERTED|HEDGED_ASSERTION -> PRESENT; MATCH + QUOTED|HYPOTHETICAL|NEGATED|SELF_RETRACTED -> ABSENT; MATCH + NONCOMMITTAL|UNRESOLVED -> UNRESOLVED; NO_MATCH -> ABSENT; match-UNRESOLVED -> UNRESOLVED; claim truth irrelevant

M2_unresolved_first_class.rule: CLEAR_TRIGGER_SUPPORT -> TRIGGERED; CLEAR_NON_TRIGGER_SUPPORT -> NOT_TRIGGERED; AMBIGUOUS|INSUFFICIENT|UNRESOLVED -> UNRESOLVED; AMBIGUOUS_CRITICAL_FORCED_BINARY = 0

calibration.interpretation: calibration is prompt/schema/mapping validation, not a model-accuracy gate; residual cells are model observations and instrument (fixture-text) defects, recorded for official-set design

clarification_iterations.scope: parser: accept flat per-dimension schema as instructed; envelope accepted for compatibility
span validator: narrow symmetric diacritic folding as second-step match; accepted minimal-pair limitation documented

known_instrument_defects: M2-24 fixture text corrupted ASCII ('flger' for 'foelger'): quote-anchored answer unmatchable; cell not model-evaluable
M2-14 fixture text corrupted ASCII ('gr' for 'goer'): model missed intended conflicting-signal reading; cell contaminated by instrument
policy: such defects are recorded and excluded-eligible only as instrument exclusions in official-set design; no fixture edits after results
freeze_statement: prompt, schema, derivation tables, parser, model config, validation metrics, and official fixture generation rules are frozen from this point; official validation follows spec sections 27-36
